article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This capture is a freerealms.com 'What is New?' news index page. Its only article content is a headline, 'The Free Realms Holiday Pass!', posted 2 weeks and 5 days before the capture date, with no body text. It gives a rebuilder no details on what the Holiday Pass contained, cost, or how it worked.
